title: Divisibility survives multiplying the dividend
statement: For naturals a, b, c: if a divides b then a divides b * c.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.dvd x0 x1) -> AxNat.dvd x0 (AxNat.mul x1 x2)))))

evidence.supports: Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
